newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill yield rises at auction.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill yield rises at auction.

text.p: The average yield on 91-day Lithuanian Treasury bills rose to 10.16 percent from 9.56 percent earlier in the week, the central bank said on Friday.
The bank held an extra T-bill auction this week because Monday and Tuesday are public holidays.
MATURITY AV YIELD LAST TIME MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD
Settlement date for the auction is March 13, and the bills mature on June 12.
The next auction is on March 8 when 50 million litas ($12.5 million) of 91-day T-bills will be offered.
